system.summary: Simple substitution of Hungarian letters by drawn signs, no word division: vowels as groups of bars with dots or ticks for long and umlaut forms, consonants as simple shapes; OVAL = cs, S and 8 both k.

diacritics.note: a dot or tick above a vowel sign gives the long or umlaut form (á, é, ő, ü, i); two dots give ö.

system.notes: distinct_symbols = sign types in the transcription (measured, 30); the key gives 29 a value (EX+aa, 1 token, none). The label V1+a stands for at least three written signs (h, d, p) not yet separated, so the true sign count is higher. key_order: vowels follow a bar-count pattern (two bars a, three e); consonants have no order seen.

prior_solution.where: None found as far as checked: DECODE (all 120 records, Available Documents empty), Cyphersolver issues/PRs/catalogue/leads/targets, Schrödel's HistoCrypt paper (76 cards of his collection have known plaintext, not named), web. Not checked: Schrödel's books and talks, HathiTrust/Google Books full text. The owner may hold a private reading.

conditions.human_role: Malcolm McBratney chose the target, set the rules (prior art first, freeze before one decode, held-out card, first pass of record, 65% line, 5,000-key shuffles at seeds 20261112 and 7), wrote to the owner and directed filing; Claude sessions transcribed, solved, decoded, judged and checked. No person has checked the transcription, key or decode.
tools: Hungarian no-space 4-gram model built from 10 Project Gutenberg texts (scripts/build_hu_lm_ns.py; not filed)
models: Claude as AI judge of the decode (24 Nov 2026; exact model id and isolation not recorded)

solution.what: Prior art: all 120 DECODE records enumerated (no cleartext, key or decryption; 8 public, 112 gated), Cyphersolver searched, Schrödel's HistoCrypt paper and web (PRIOR_ART.md). None found.
Full images of the 8 public cards fetched without login; the 112 gated cards return a placeholder to an ordinary account and were not reached.

Neutral sign labels written (SIGNS.md); main text block of 7 cards transcribed, 155 lines, 2,795 signs (measured); card 91 (faint pencil) not transcribed. Card 96 chosen as held out (619 signs, 22.1%). Frozen 11:19:28Z before key work.
solve.py v1 on the training cards, seed 1, many-to-one keys: plain words leaked into the stream and the search collapsed to 'tetete...'. Key discarded.

solve.py v2, one-to-one keys, Hungarian no-space 4-gram model, training cards only (2,176 signs); seeds 1, 7 and 20261112 all reach the same key at -3.9156 per sign; decode reads as Hungarian ('szeretet ... egyetlen remenyem ne haragudjon').

Training decode read for key repair: EIGHT c->k (kedves-), OVAL h->cs (csak, becses), V1 p->d (edes). Fault found: label V1+a merges h, d and p; transcription frozen, not corrected. Key frozen 11:28:06Z, before card 96 was decoded.

One decode of the held-out card 96 with the frozen key: running Hungarian on the first and only pass ('szeretet édes jolankám édes egyetlen remenyem kivanom [h]ogy a leg[j]obb egessegben találja soraim').

5,000 key shuffles (values permuted within vowels and within consonants) at seeds 20261112 and 7, same 4-gram model: 0 of 5,000 reach the real key on the held-out card at either seed (6.9 sd), nor on training or all cards. Solver on shuffled ciphertext not run.

AI judge (Claude) scored every decoded letter S/E/N under a brief written before scoring: held-out card 96 S 520/623 = 83.5%; training 1,803/2,184 = 82.6%; lowest card 77 68.8%. Over the project's 65% line. Stamped 11:37:44Z.
Filing check: 15 filed files verify against the 24 Nov stamp manifest; lengths re-measured with docs/_check_profile.py --measure (2,795 signs, 30 types).

outcome.method_basis: Key recovered by simulated annealing on six training cards (same key at three seeds), three values set from the training decode, frozen before the held-out card 96 was decoded. Card 96: AI judge S 520/623 = 83.5% of letters in words that read as Hungarian sense (first pass, no emendation); key shuffles 0/5,000 at seeds 20261112 and 7. The text is not yet read as sentences and has no translation: one transcription label merges h, d and p, a/e and n/m are confused in places, and no person has read it, so every text is 'decoded, not read'. The key is partial: V1+a stands for three signs and EX+aa has no value.
outcome.fraction_read_source: judge/judge.tsv, held-out card 96: letters scored S by an AI judge (520/623); not a person's reading

texts.summary: Courtship cards from a man to Tóth Jolánka: greetings ('szeretett édes Jolánkám'), wishes for her health, thanks for her letters, his work and duty, 'Isten vele édesem'. Gist from the decode, not checked by a Hungarian reader.
